lessonTitle: 34. The volume of a truncated pyramid
lessonTitleEnglish: The volume of a truncated pyramid
unit: Geometry · Chapter I. Volumes of solids
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 12 mathematics textbooks (general stream)

stages.headline: A truncated pyramid has volume V = ⅓ h (S₁ + √(S₁S₂) + S₂), where S₁ and S₂ are the base areas.
stages.headlineEnglish: A truncated pyramid has volume V = ⅓ h (S₁ + √(S₁S₂) + S₂), where S₁ and S₂ are the base areas.

stages.headline: Example: S₁ = 16, S₂ = 4, h = 3 give V = ⅓ · 3 · (16 + 8 + 4) = 28.
stages.headlineEnglish: Example: S₁ = 16, S₂ = 4, h = 3 give V = ⅓ · 3 · (16 + 8 + 4) = 28.

stages.headline: A truncated pyramid is the big pyramid minus the small pyramid cut off it.
stages.headlineEnglish: A truncated pyramid is the big pyramid minus the small pyramid cut off it.
